protocol:
AEROZOO reduction (2026-10-10; pre-registration #sec-nb-aerozoo-prereg): ISLA, ISLA-DTT and GeoTransolver at their reference
configurations on AeroZoo v1.2's interior task, in distribution (`full`) and with an enclosure family (`family_non_box`), a Reynolds
range (`reynolds`) or the blob bank (`bank_blobs`) held out. Reads the scoring records fetched by fetch_scores.sh into scores/<run>/
{val,test}/metrics.jsonl (float32, the training draw, per-case relative L2 per field; the last record per case counts), the per-case
labels of case_labels.json (stability population, enclosure, bank, Reynolds number) and the lanes' training records (validation
trajectory every ten epochs, step time and memory of the final epoch). Writes aerozoo_reduction.json:
  fields                     metric key -> label
  splits[split]              label, held-out family, the run stem
  arms[arm][split][side]     fields[f] = {mean, per_seed, n_cases, n_seeds}; by_quality[q][f]; by_label[kind][value][f] (test sides);
                             absent_fields: the fields no case reports (the velocity-plus-pressure lanes: nut, tke, omega)
  ratios[split][side][arm]   arm ÷ ISLA per field: seed-mean ratio, per-seed ratios, both_seeds_agree, counts (outside 1 ± 0.05)
  penalties[split][arm]      test error of the split's own model ÷ the same arm's `full` test error, per field (P2, P3)
  predictions                P1, P2, P4 verdicts against the pre-registered bars
  cost[arm][split]           median step seconds and peak memory of the final epoch, parameters, epochs completed, GPU-hours
  trajectories[run]          [{epoch, loss, <field>_l2 ...}] from val_summary rows
  events[run]                the instability detector over that trajectory: best_epoch, best_loss, event_epoch (first validation
                             epoch whose loss exceeds twice the running minimum, None if never), last_epoch, last_loss
  bestval[arm][split][side]  the labeled best-checkpoint DIAGNOSTIC (never the standing): the kept checkpoint after the trainer's
                             validation minimum, scored like the protocol on the validation (scores/<run>/bestval/) and test
                             (scores/<run>/bestval_test/) sides; block shape as arms plus the chosen epoch per seed
  remedy[arm]                R1-R3 verdicts of the half-rate arms (#sec-nb-aerozoo-remedy-prereg) against their reference-rate twins
The splits and arms are the pre-registered ones below plus every other split and arm of lanes.tsv (2026-10-14: the matrix's
eighteen splits; the 500-epoch, WALLDIST, H-FRAME and velocity-plus-pressure arms). A seed mean is over the seeds present; a block
is `complete` only when both seeds are scored.
usage: python aerozoo_reduce.py [--out aerozoo_reduction.json]

family_non_box.label: enclosure family held out (trained on external boxes)

bank_zero_to_cad.label: bank zero to cad held out

P1.statement: full test side: GeoTransolver ÷ ISLA >= 1.2 on velocity and <= 0.9 on pressure; falsified below 1.1 on velocity or above 1.0 on pressure

P2.statement: ISLA's held-out-enclosure penalty (family_non_box test ÷ full test, same arm) at least 20% smaller than GeoTransolver's; falsified if not smaller

P4.statement: ISLA-DTT's full test error within 5% of ISLA's on every field

ISLA (half rate).verdict: no doubling through 250 epochs and the finals read velocity at or below 0.25 on the validation side: cured

p1_reread.statement: GeoTransolver ÷ ISLA (half rate) on full test velocity >= 1.4 under R2

ISLA-DTT (half rate).verdict: no doubling through epoch 160 so far; lanes unfinished

p1_reread.statement: GeoTransolver ÷ ISLA-DTT (half rate) on full test velocity >= 1.4 under R2
